name: software-factory
description: An AI software factory: a CTO agent turns goals into work for 14 role agents that plan, design, build, review and test code in one repo or across a folder of repos, with teams mapped to tracker teams, bug and tech-debt streams, cycles, CTO baselines and reports, human approval gates, a local control center and two-way tracker sync.

linear_api_key.title: Linear API key
linear_api_key.description: Personal or bot API key used by tracker sync for Linear. Leave empty if you do not use Linear.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Only needed if the gh CLI is not logged in. Needs repo scope, plus project scope for Projects. Empty means use gh auth.

jira_site.title: Jira site
jira_site.description: Your Atlassian site, for example yourcompany.atlassian.net. Leave empty if you do not use Jira.

jira_email.title: Jira account email
jira_email.description: Atlassian account email used with the Jira API token.

jira_api_token.title: Jira API token
jira_api_token.description: API token from id.atlassian.com. Leave empty if you do not use Jira.

sync_enabled.title: Tracker sync on this machine
sync_enabled.description: Kill switch. Off stops all tracker network calls from this machine.

desktop_notifications.title: Desktop notifications
desktop_notifications.description: Show an OS notification when a gate waits for you, a budget reaches 80 percent, or the loop stops.

max_parallel_agents.title: Machine cap on parallel agents
max_parallel_agents.description: Upper bound for this machine. The repo setting concurrency.total is clamped to it.
